title: Chapter 238 Am I Willing To Come?
content:
Chapter 238 Am I Willing To Come?

As soon as I entered the alchemy club, a strong fragrance of medicine came to my face.

"It smells so good."

"I just sniffed this breath and I could already feel the boiling of the immortal power in my body."

Qin Feng and Xiao Luo looked emotional.

Only Lu Xue frowned and looked at the two of them, "As for it?"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Qin Feng waved his hand and said, "Miss Lu, this is the elixir refined from the Alchemy Peak, and you can't buy it with money."

In other words, it is the elixir here, even wealthy families like Lu Xue should cherish it.

However, Xiao Luo, who was standing aside, did not think so.

Just kidding, although he is not particularly clear about who Lu Xue is, he learned from the seniors of the family that Lu Xue's father would be respectful even if his ancestors met him.

Although there may be some exaggerated elements, it will never be much worse.

He and Xiao clan can have their own alchemy master, so the power behind Lu Xue will not be worse than their Xiao clan.

This is what Xiao Luo thought.

Sure enough, when he heard Qin Feng's words, Lu Xue shook her head and said, "I don't want the elixir here for free."

Although I don't know much about elixirs.

But I eat a lot.

The worst pill Lu Daosheng gave him, the feeling she felt much better than any medicine here.

Lu Xue's voice was not loud, but for some reason, the noisy sound around her suddenly became quiet.

Suddenly, everyone's eyes looked at Lu Xue and the other two.

At this moment, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo were also stunned.

Miss, what are you saying?

Qin Feng's face looked even worse than eating shit. He would slander the pills here when he was refining alchemy. It is no exaggeration to say that Lu Xue's words can directly offend half of the academy.

The next moment, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo just looked at each other, and then immediately rushed to Lu Xue's side and covered Lu Xue's mouth directly.

"Um,"

"Ahhaha, sorry, sorry, everyone, my friend took the wrong medicine."

Qin Feng covered Lu Xue's mouth and smiled at everyone.

At this time, Lu Xue broke free and said unhappy: "You just took the wrong medicine!"

And she didn't brag, and she probably won't even take a look at the pills here when she threw them on the ground.

Lu Xue is very clear about her worth.

"Wait a minute, aren't those two disciples of Senior Xiao Yin?"

In the crowd, a sharp-eyed person recognized Lu Xue and the others and spoke immediately.

As soon as these words came out, everyone's expressions suddenly became complicated.

The next moment, a woman in a long blue dress slowly walked out of the crowd and then walked towards Lu Xue and the others.

The woman had a beautiful face, and a faint fragrance of medicine was revealed all over her body, just like a natural medicinal herb.

"Girl, I don't care whose disciple you are, but this is an alchemy club. When you are a alchemy club, you are openly slandering the elixirs from my alchemy club, and I have the right to expel you."

The woman's soft voice sounded from the scene, but her dissatisfaction with Lu Xue inside and outside.

When the woman heard the woman's words, no one around objected, but instead nodded slightly to express his agreement.

"This, Fairy Bai, my friend didn't do it intentionally, there's no need to do that."

At this time, Qin Feng stood up and hugged the woman and said.

Lu Xue and the other two didn't know the woman in front of them, but he knew it too well.

Bai Lushuang, a disciple of Master Jordanyang, is now the leader of the alchemy Taoist in the alchemy peak, and is also the leader of the young generation of the entire fairyland.

He once refined an Immortal Emperor Child Pill with his cultivation level in the Immortal Saint Realm, which was famous in the Immortal Realm.

At the same time, she is also the head of this alchemy meeting.

Although he knew that he could not change the ending of what he said, and even implicated him so much that he was forced to leave the alchemy club, he still chose to stand up.

Qin Feng's words made Bai Lushuang look slightly sideways.

Just as he was about to speak, Lu Xue suddenly said coldly: "If you expel it, just expel it, it makes me feel happy to come."

Immediately, Lu Xue turned around and left casually.

Before leaving, he even spat at the alchemy club.

“he~tui!”

In an instant, the entire alchemy will fall into ghostly silence again.

At this moment, Qin Feng was completely stunned.

Leaving,

Is it leaving now?

I also want to ease the relationship between Lu Xue and the Alchemy Association.

Now, isn't this just blown up?

At this time, Xiao Luo also recovered, and then Xiao Luo bowed to Qin Feng and said, "Thank you, Brother Qin, for bringing me to open my eyes, but let it go this time."

After saying that, Xiao Luo did not hesitate and turned around and left the alchemy club.

Obviously, Xiao Luo went to chase Lu Xue.

Standing there, Qin Feng felt extremely embarrassed for a moment, and he was about to pick out a room on his toes.

In the crowd, everyone whispered.

"Those two guys are finished. This move has completely offended the alchemist of the entire Alchemy Peak."

"That's right, it's not easy for them to get in the academy in the future."

"It's too early. Have you forgotten that the mentors of those two are Senior Xiao Yin?"

Everyone has different opinions. Some people think that if they offend the Alchemy Peak, their future will inevitably be extremely bumpy.

But some people believe that learning from Senior Xiao Yin will not be bad no matter what.

Bai Lushuang, the head of the alchemy club, looked at the direction of Lu Xue and the others leaving with a plain face. She would not care about Lu Xue and the others' identities.

No matter whether she is Xiao Yin or Xiao clan, she will deny her alchemist.

That is the dignity of an alchemist, and she must maintain it.

As for the consequences, she had never thought about them at all.

Looking at the entire fairyland, is there anyone or force who dares to oppose their alchemist?

Even Xiao Yin can't do it.

Thinking of this, Bai Lushuang also felt relieved and looked at Qin Feng who was still confused.

"Qin Feng, you have always had a good relationship with my Alchemy Peak, not to mention that this time the matter has nothing to do with you. You can still stay in the next alchemy meeting."

Bai Lushuang spoke to Qin Feng like a generous person.

This is the impact of her status and status for a long time. In her opinion, except for her master, everyone around her will only compliment her unconditionally.

After saying this, Qin Feng probably was already moved and burst into tears.

However, Qin Feng did thank her.

only,,

"Thank you Fairy Bai for your kindness. However, Qin is afraid that he will lose his companion for this alchemy meeting."

After saying that, Qin Feng hugged his fists and turned around and left.

Seeing Qin Feng leave, Bai Lushuang was stunned for a moment, and suddenly she frowned slightly. She turned to look at the two disciples of the Tianjian Sect with long swords on their backs in the corner. They also spread their hands and shook their heads and smiled bitterly.

Seeing this, Bai Lushuang sighed and then continued to preside over the alchemy meeting.
